turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Marcus, Sarah here. Let us talk about your warehouse solar enquiry.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Our electricity bill is rising, but the roof and financing worry me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: An assessment should look at roof condition, consumption, and operating hours before discussing system size. Then you can compare installation costs with an estimated savings range.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Are you assuming we qualify for rebates?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No. Incentives depend on your location and eligibility. The specialist should verify those separately and show the numbers with and without them.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is helpful. Could we review the details tomorrow afternoon?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Certainly, Marcus. In this demo, we would capture those notes and request a suitable appointment.
